// Per-product logo attributes, included by the document header. Defines the
// product logo once for both outputs; swapping products swaps only this file
// — the shared docinfo.html / pdf-theme.yml never change.
// (No blank lines: this file is spliced into the document header.)
// Product logo as a self-contained SVG data URI (single source of truth).
// Regenerate (SVGO-optimized) from logos/terminal-api.svg, ideally via the CI.
// Consumed by docinfo.html:  background-image: url("{logo-product-datauri}")
:logo-product-datauri: data:image/svg+xml;base64,
// PDF title-page logo — reuses the data URI above so the PDF stays self-contained
// too (no external SVG at build). Rendered on the cover via asciidoctor-pdf's
// built-in title-logo-image attribute.
:title-logo-image: image:{logo-product-datauri}[pdfwidth=4.0in]
